sources.title: Prisoner Wellbeing (Safer Custody) - POPS
sources.quote: When a loved one is sent to prison, it's natural to feel concerned about their well-being, especially in the unfamiliar environment of a custodial setting. One of the key priorities of the prison service is **safer custody**, which refers to the systems and procedures in place to protect individuals from harm, ensure their physical and mental well-being, and prevent self-harm or incidents of violence
